description: Inventory: warehouses, lots, transfers, stocktakes and an append-only ledger. A charter, requirements, milestones, an ADR, a threat model, a contract and sample tasks.

project_name.description: The name used in the charter heading.

test_command.description: The unit and integration test command.

build_command.description: The build command, used by the track but not run by init.

rollback_command.description: The rollback command; it must be rehearsed before M3 is done.

post_init: Read .space/charter.md and tick every item under ## Ready.
Run oc-harness spec check, then research, design and decompose.
The sample in .space/plan/tasks.sample.md is a shape, not a plan; decompose writes the real .space/tasks.md.
Rehearse the rollback command before M3 is done.
